native.notAvailable: Not available — recorded guidance is used
native.deleteConfirm: Delete all household data from this iPhone?
native.deleteFooter: Removes the family, layout, saved places, plans and encryption key from this iPhone. Shared copies cannot be recalled.
native.translationNotice: Spanish and Vietnamese are draft translations awaiting language review.
native.privateStorage: Family details are encrypted on this iPhone. The key stays here; private data is excluded from device backups and cannot be restored on a new phone. Sharing or printing creates a copy outside DryRun.
native.publicBoundary: Supported public resources use only a public region identifier. Apple receives address searches and ordinary directions requests when you use those features.
native.prototype: Prototype: safety content and translations await expert review.
native.unlockDetail: Your encrypted family data can be opened after this device is unlocked. Nothing was deleted.
native.saveError: The saved data was kept. Your draft remains available; try saving again after the current operation finishes.
native.recovery: Your saved family data could not be opened
native.recoveryDetail: The encrypted file was kept. Retry after unlocking or updating the app. A missing key or damaged file needs recovery; starting over deletes it.
native.startOver: Start over and delete stored data
native.recoveryDelete: Delete unreadable data and start over?
native.localHelp: Official resources and alerts are not available for this location. Keep local emergency contacts in your family card.
native.removePersonNote: Their person-specific details and checks will be removed. Equipment stays recorded but becomes unassigned, and helpers must be chosen again where needed. Tap Save to apply this change.
native.removeEquipmentNote: This removes only this item and its preparation records. Family members, backup sources, contacts and places stay recorded. The change is saved when you confirm.
ui.scene.accountedOutside: {person}: accounted for outside in this exercise.
ui.scene.exitedNeedsAccounting: {person}: reached outside. Account for them at the meeting point.
ui.brief.cloudNote: Suggestions use this fictional family’s recorded details. Review them before acting.
experience.setup.title: Set up this practice
experience.setup.caption: Choose exercise conditions. Your household facts and readiness score stay unchanged.
experience.setup.noHome: A home layout is not recorded. Spatial limits will remain explicit.
experience.scene.notMeasured: Exercise assumptions, not measurements or safety predictions.
experience.scene.notTracked: This run does not record individual arrivals.
experience.scene.noLedger: No comparable resource readings are recorded.
experience.scene.noFuture: Only revealed exercise events appear here.
experience.scene.noAdvisory: No advisory recorded at this step
experience.scene.waterCaveat: Service restoration does not clear an advisory. Boiling does not resolve a do-not-drink or do-not-use condition.
experience.scene.followAdvisory: Use depends on supply and the current advisory.
experience.scene.temperatureUnknown: Temperature is not modeled in this run.
experience.scene.noSafety: Arrivals and routes are exercise results; structural safety is not assessed.
experience.debrief.title: What this practice tested
experience.home-fire.objective: Get out, then account for everyone
experience.home-fire.debrief: Review the exit actually used, any shared chokepoint, and who was accounted for outside. Do not reenter for people, pets or belongings.
experience.home-fire.setup.timing.why: Night changes the starting assumptions, not the household record.
experience.home-fire.setup.exit: Which exit condition will you practice?
experience.home-fire.setup.exit.why: Compare the available route with an exit made unavailable in the exercise.
experience.tornado.objective: Reach shelter and keep an alert channel
experience.tornado.debrief: Review each shelter approach, recorded assistance, building limits and alert continuity. Arrival does not certify structural safety.
experience.tornado.setup.timing.why: Night adds a warning-continuity check using recorded radio and phone dependencies. It does not move people automatically.
experience.tornado.setup.impact.why: Damage is an explicit exercise condition, never a prediction from the scan.
experience.flash-flood.debrief: Review when departure was available, which links or supplies became inaccessible, and whether a person-specific higher refuge was supported.
experience.flash-flood.setup.event: Which water event are you practicing?
experience.flash-flood.setup.event.why: A household leak and regional flash flooding have different decisions.
experience.flash-flood.setup.extent.why: This is a stated exercise assumption, not elevation or flood clearance from a room scan.
experience.freeze-power-loss.objective: Keep warmth and essential power in view
experience.freeze-power-loss.debrief: Compare actual reserve use, recorded warmth and the heated alternative. Electrical service does not establish medical-device continuity.
experience.freeze-power-loss.setup.durat: Which outage duration will you practice?
A longer authored outage changes resource pressure over simulated hours.
experience.freeze-power-loss.setup.focus: What will you watch most closely?
This highlights relevant readings; it does not create supplies or change consumption.
experience.heat-grid-strain.objective: Keep cooling workable as conditions change
experience.heat-grid-strain.debrief: Review cooling availability, affected rooms, water access and the recorded alternative. Illustrative temperatures are not medical limits.
experience.heat-grid-strain.setup.grid: Does the exercise include rotating outages?
experience.heat-grid-strain.setup.grid.w: Heat can require adaptation while household electricity still works.
This changes emphasis on screen, not household facts or resource arithmetic.
experience.water-outage.objective: Match the supply to the activity and advisory
experience.water-outage.scene: Tap service, quality and stored water
experience.water-outage.debrief: Review the actual supply used, remaining volume and activity under the advisory. Restored tap flow does not by itself clear a quality warning.
experience.water-outage.setup.advisory: Which quality warning will you practice?
experience.water-outage.setup.advisory.w: Boil-water, do-not-drink and do-not-use are different conditions.
experience.water-outage.setup.power.why: A water outage does not automatically imply a blackout.
experience.flash-flood.setup.focus: What will you keep in view?
experience.flash-flood.setup.focus.why: Highlight access or supply services. This does not change which rooms are affected.
experience.context.assistance: A recorded assistance need can change the approach. Practice the actual route and support arrangement; do not assume a helper can arrive.
experience.context.equipment: This recorded dependency can compete for power or cooling. Compare documented backup and storage arrangements in the exercise.
experience.context.waterUnknown: Stored drinking-water quantity is not confirmed
experience.context.water: Check which supply is usable and accessible for the activity. An unknown quantity is not an empty supply.
experience.setup.roomAssumption: This selects an exercise condition. A room scan does not predict where fire or water will spread.
experience.scene.leak: Local water and electrical access: keep the affected area clear. Regional road closure is not assumed.
experience.scene.leakReview: Review the selected affected area and the route that stays clear of water and electrical hazards. Get appropriate help without entering the affected area.
experience.scene.routeFactsUnknown: Some opening or access facts remain unknown. Review the specific route gap.
experience.water-outage.setup.focus: Which dependency will you keep in view?
experience.water-outage.setup.focus.why: The recorded water source is not municipal. This exercise uses its supported supply and power conditions, without applying a municipal utility advisory to a private well.
experience.scene.baselineScale: Fill is relative to this exercise’s recorded starting stock, not a household target.
experience.home-fire.setup.smoke: Which smoke condition will you practice?
experience.home-fire.setup.smoke.why: Practice the recorded route with the authored hallway-smoke condition. It changes the exercise, not the household record.
experience.debrief.routeAvailable: A route was available in this evaluation.
experience.debrief.routesNotArrivals: These are route evaluations, not recorded arrivals.
experience.debrief.relocation.used: The recorded relocation arrangement was used.
experience.debrief.relocation.blocked: Relocation was blocked by the recorded arrangement or access conditions.
experience.setup.startingRooms.why: Use recorded rooms or choose exercise starting rooms. This does not move people in your household record.
native.aboutBeacon: Beacon is Dry Run's assistant. It runs on AI models from Google (Gemini), Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI or Groq, depending on how this build is set up; names, phone numbers and addresses are never sent.
native.sampleFamilyDetail: Fictional families and homes to explore the app. They replace the example on this phone; your own household is never replaced from here.
native.sampleFamilyBlocked: Your own household is saved on this phone. Delete it below first if you want to try a sample family.
native.sampleReplaceHome: Replace your own home with a sample home? Your scan or drawing cannot be recovered afterwards.
